$comment: Deterministic gates. Critical checks are encoded here and in scripts/conformance.sh rather than relying on an agent remembering to run them (master directive section 15).

hooks.command: f=$(cat | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))'); case "$f" in *.py) [ -x .venv/bin/ruff ] && .venv/bin/ruff check --quiet "$f" || true;; *.hml) [ -x .venv/bin/hml ] && .venv/bin/hml check "$f" || true;; *.json) python3 -c "import json,sys; json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))" "$f" || true;; esac
[ -x .venv/bin/python ] && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/parser tests/type_system tests/roundtrip tests/golden -q --no-header 2>&1 | tail -3 || true
